nodes.title: LC Skin Beauty ✨
widgets_values:
# LC Skin Beauty ✨ — Quick controls (workflow)

Skin-only cool & brighten under a mask. **Preset** loads the sliders; change any slider after that.

## Presets
| Preset | Use when |
|--------|----------|
| **Natural** | Everyday cleanup, balanced |
| **Light** | Subtle touch-up |
| **Fresh** | Brighter, cooler “clean” look |
| **Porcelain** | Stronger brighten / evenness (easy to overdo) |
| **Warm keep** | Keep warmth; less cool shift, more rosy |
| **Custom** | Starting point you edit freely |

## Main controls
| Control | What it does |
|---------|----------------|
| **strength** | 0 = original, 1 = full effect |
| **coolness** | Less yellow / cooler skin |
| **brightness** | Lift / whiten skin (highlights protected) |
| **rosy** | Pink flush (− = less red) |
| **evenness** | Smoother local skin tone |
| **shadow_lift** | Open dark areas on skin |
| **smooth** | Soften texture (raise carefully) |
| **texture_preserve** | Keep pores/detail (raise if plastic) |
| **saturation** | Skin chroma (− = calmer) |
| **highlight_protect** | Guard bright spots from over-whitening |
| **mask_sensitivity** | How picky the auto skin mask is |
| **mask_feather** | Soft edge on the mask |

## Tips
- Optional **MASK** (e.g. SAM person) limits effect to skin *inside* the person.
- Check **skin_mask** output if fabric or hair picks up the grade.
- Prefer **Natural** / **Warm keep** first; raise **texture_preserve**, lower **smooth** if it looks plastic.

---
# LC Skin Beauty ✨ — 控件速查（工作流）

仅对皮肤做降温/提亮（蒙版内）。**预设**会写入滑条；之后可再手动改。

## 预设
| 预设 | 适用 |
|------|------|
| **Natural** | 日常修肤，均衡 |
| **Light** | 轻微修饰 |
| **Fresh** | 更亮、更冷的干净感 |
| **Porcelain** | 更强提亮/均匀（易过头） |
| **Warm keep** | 保留暖调；少降温、多红润 |
| **Custom** | 自定义起点 |

## 主要控件
| 控件 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| **strength** | 0 = 原图，1 = 满效果 |
| **coolness** | 减少发黄 / 更冷肤色 |
| **brightness** | 提亮/美白皮肤（高光有保护） |
| **rosy** | 红润（负值 = 少红） |
| **evenness** | 局部肤色更均匀 |
| **shadow_lift** | 提亮皮肤暗部 |
| **smooth** | 柔化纹理（慎加） |
| **texture_preserve** | 保留毛孔/细节（发塑再调高） |
| **saturation** | 皮肤饱和度（负 = 更淡） |
| **highlight_protect** | 防止高光被过度提亮 |
| **mask_sensitivity** | 自动皮肤蒙版灵敏度 |
| **mask_feather** | 蒙版边缘羽化 |

## 提示
- 可选 **MASK**（如 SAM 人物）把效果限制在人物内的皮肤。
- 衣服/头发吃效果时，查看 **skin_mask** 输出。
- 先试 **Natural** / **Warm keep**；发假再提高 **texture_preserve**、降低 **smooth**。

**LC Notify 🔊**
- hook to any node outlet.
- plays a selected sound upon completion
- select from a list of preloaded sounds or place your own in the folder shown below



```
📂 ComfyUI/
│─ 📂 custom_nodes
│  ├── 📂 ComfyUI_LC123_nodes
│  │  └── 📂 assets
│  │      └──📂 sounds
│  │         └── any .mp3 sound
```

nodes.title: # LC123 Performance Settings ⚙️
widgets_values:
# LC123 Performance Settings ⚙️

> **UI only** — smoother scrolling and lighter on-node previews.  
> These settings do **not** change generation VRAM, model load, or output image quality on the sockets.

---

## Where to find them

1. Open **ComfyUI Settings** (gear).
2. In the sidebar, open **LC123**.
3. Open **Performance**.

If you don’t see the full list: restart ComfyUI, then **Ctrl+F5** (hard refresh) so the updated `web/lc_performance_settings.js` loads.

---

## What each option does

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|--------|---------|----------------|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | Turns off hover A/B wipe on **image FX** nodes. Last result still shows. |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | Draws FX previews at **half** the node’s image area (less GPU/CPU work while panning). |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | Downscales the **on-node** preview bitmap so the longest side ≤ **Max edge**. |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | Used only when **Clamp longest side** is on. Try 512–1024 on heavy graphs. |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | Collapsed FX nodes skip drawing previews (less work while scrolling). |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hides all LC **image FX** on-node previews. Socket outputs are unchanged. |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | **LC Skin Beauty** keeps a **full-quality** on-node preview even if half-res / clamp are on (for zooming skin detail). Wipe still follows **Remove wipe**. |

---

## What is *not* affected

These stay fully interactive and are **not** driven by the Performance toggles:

- **LC Image Compare 🔎**
- **LC Dynamic Overlay**
- **LC Image Split 🖼️**

Generation, Save Image, and every **IMAGE** output socket still use full resolution.

---

## Suggested setups

### Default (shipped)
Leave everything at default: full FX previews, wipe on, Skin Beauty override on.

### Heavy graph / laggy scroll
1. Turn **Half-resolution previews** **On**  
2. Turn **Clamp longest side** **On** (Max edge **512** or **768**)  
3. Keep **No preview when collapsed** **On**  
4. Leave **Skin Beauty full preview override** **On** if you still inspect skin on the node  

### Maximum UI lightness
1. **Hide FX on-node previews** **On**  
2. Or use **Remove wipe** + half-res + clamp  
3. Use **Image Compare** / **Image Split** when you need a wipe  

---

## Notes

- Changes apply on the next canvas redraw (panning or queue is enough; no reinstall needed).
- Optional SAM / LayerStyle / big models are separate from these settings; they still use their own VRAM.
- Pack files: `web/lc_performance_settings.js`, `web/lc_image_preview.js`

---

nodes.title: 🎨 Post Processing Notes
widgets_values:
## Instructions

# 🛑🚫✋ I HIGHLY suggest that you fix the seed, run the pic, then don’t mess with anything before this so it doesn’t reprocess.

## VRAM issues. See LC123 Performance Settings ⚙️ Note.

### Node order (follow the chain top → bottom)

**Smart Denoise (LCImageDenoise)**
- Removes noise while trying to keep detail
- Sigma: higher = smoother, lower = more detail
- Threshold: how aggressive the denoise is
- Radius Multiplier: higher for noisy images, lower for clean ones  
💡 Start gentle. Only raise values if the image is actually noisy.

**Color Match (LCColorMatch)**
- Matches colors to a reference image (usually Image 2)
- Method: **adain** is the most common and stable
- Strength: 0–1
- **Skin protect:** reduces how hard the match hits skin regions (keep faces from shifting hue oddly)  
💡 Great for series consistency. No reference → node can bypass / pass through without erroring.

**Bloom (LCBloom)**
- Soft glow on bright areas (camera light bloom)
- Intensity, threshold, and size controls  
💡 A little makes it dreamy. A lot makes it foggy.

**Vignette (LCVignette)**
- Darkens (or lightens) the edges
- Amount, softness, and roundness  
💡 Soft vignette looks more natural than hard black borders.

**Image RGB (LCImageRGB)**
- Simple red / green / blue channel gain

**Lift / Gamma / Gain (LCLiftGammaGain)**
- Classic three-way color corrector
- Lift = shadows · Gamma = midtones · Gain = highlights  
💡 This is where most “film look” color work happens.

**Auto White Balance (LCAutoWhiteBalance)**
- Tries to neutralize overall color cast
- Method: “Shades of Gray” is usually safest  
💡 Effect is subtle — compare before/after.

**Vibrance (LCVibrance)**
- Boosts muted colors without destroying already-saturated areas
- Kinder to skin than normal saturation
- Vibrance + Saturation + Strength  
💡 Prefer this over regular saturation for portraits.

**Chromatic Aberration (LCChromaticAberration)**
- Shifts RGB channels for a 3-D / vintage lens look
- Separate horizontal/vertical amounts for R, G, B  
💡 A little goes a long way. Try small opposite values (R +2, G –1, B –3).

**Sharpen Pro (LCSharpenPro)**
- **Photorealism-first** mid-tone clarity + edge sharpen (not “ink outline” by default)
- **Clarity** = local structure · **Sharpen** = finer edge detail · **Strength** = overall mix vs original
- **Halo** + auto-raise when sharpen is high · **Skin protect** for faces
- Advanced: radius, blend mode, shadow / highlight protect
- **Presets fill the sliders** (moving a slider → **Custom**):
  - **Realism:** Natural · Subtle · Portrait · Product · Landscape · Crisp  
  - **Art:** Lineart · Anime sharp  
💡 Start **Natural** or **Portrait** for influencers / NSFW realism. Raise clarity before sharpen. Use **Lineart / Anime sharp** only when you want deliberate edge punch.

**Image Adjust (LCImageAdjust)**
- Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Sharpness, Blur
- Brightness center = 0
- Contrast & Saturation center = 1

**LC Skin Beauty ✨**
- See Skin Beauty ✨ markdown Note

**Lens FX (LCLensFX)**
- General lens distortion and optical effects  
💡 Pair with the next node for more realistic camera simulation.

**Lens Profile (LCLensProfile)**
- Applies real lens characteristics (e.g. Canon 50mm f/1.8)
- Optional aberrations  
💡 Adds subtle optical imperfections that make AI images feel more photographic.

**Film Stock B&W (LCFilmStockBW)**
- Converts to black & white using real film responses
- 50+ stocks (Ilford HP5+, Kodak Tri-X, Fuji Acros, etc.)
- Strength + optional filter  
💡 Leave this off if you want to keep color.

**Film Stock Color (LCFilmStockColor)**
- Applies classic color film response (Ektachrome, Portra, etc.)
- Strength is the main control  
💡 0.6–0.9 often looks more natural than full strength.

**Film Grain (LCFilmGrain)**
- Realistic film grain with lots of control
- Power, scale, shadows/highlights, seed  
💡 Fixed seed keeps the grain consistent. Slightly more grain in shadows usually looks better.

**Desaturate (LCImageDesaturate)**
- Partial or full desaturation
- Several methods (luminance Rec.709 is common)  
💡 Useful right before a LUT if you want a muted base.

**Apply LUT (LCApplyLUT)**
- Applies a 3D LUT (`.cube` file)
- Strength 0–1 · Log option for certain LUTs
- **Does not download LUTs from the internet.**  
  Put `.cube` files in the folder below yourself (or keep whatever the pack may have **seeded once** from `assets/luts/` into `models/luts/` without overwriting files you already have).

```
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    └── luts/
        ├── your_look.cube
        ├── film_emulation.cube
        └── ...
```

💡 Free LUTs: freshluts.com. Strength **0.3–0.7** is often nicer than 1.0.

**Image Crop (LCImageCrop)**
- Inline crop tool
- X / Y / Width / Height or free mode  
💡 Crop after all effects so you don’t lose edge treatments (vignette, bloom, etc.).

**Text Overlay (LCTextOverlay)**
- Adds text on the final image
- Font, size, color, **alignment** (left / center / right), position, opacity
- Applies on 2nd run

**LC Watermark 💧 (LCWatermark)**
- Dynamically adds any image as a watermark
- Adjust size, location, and opacity
- Applies on the 2nd run

---

## 使用说明

# 🛑🚫✋ 强烈建议你先固定 seed，跑完图片，然后不要再动之前的任何设置，以免重新处理。

## 显存（VRAM）相关问题。请参阅 LC123 Performance Settings ⚙️（性能设置说明）。

### 节点顺序（按链条从上到下）

**智能降噪 (LCImageDenoise)**
- 在尽量保留细节的同时去除噪点
- Sigma：数值高更平滑，低则保留更多细节
- Threshold：控制降噪强度
- Radius Multiplier：噪点多的图用高值，干净的图用低值  
💡 从低数值开始。只有真正很噪的时候才提高。

**颜色匹配 (LCColorMatch)**
- 让当前图匹配参考图（通常是 Image 2）的色调
- 方法：**adain** 最常用也最稳定
- 强度：0–1
- **皮肤保护 (Skin protect)：** 减轻匹配对皮肤区域的力度，避免脸部色相被“拉偏”  
💡 做系列图统一肤色或情绪时很好用。没有参考图时可旁路/直通，不会报错。

**光晕 (LCBloom)**
- 给高光加柔和辉光，模拟相机过曝
- 强度、阈值、大小  
💡 少用一点很梦幻，多用就变雾了。

**暗角 (LCVignette)**
- 压暗（或提亮）边缘
- 强度、柔和度、圆度  
💡 柔和暗角比硬黑边自然得多。

**RGB 调整 (LCImageRGB)**
- 简单的红 / 绿 / 蓝通道增益

**Lift / Gamma / Gain (LCLiftGammaGain)**
- 经典三点校色
- Lift = 阴影 · Gamma = 中间调 · Gain = 高光  
💡 大部分“胶片感”颜色工作都在这里完成。

**自动白平衡 (LCAutoWhiteBalance)**
- 尝试中和整体色偏
- 方法：“Shades of Gray” 通常最稳妥  
💡 效果比较细微，记得对比前后。

**自然饱和度 (LCVibrance)**
- 提升不饱和颜色，对已经很艳的颜色和肤色更友好
- 自然饱和度 + 饱和度 + 强度  
💡 人像优先用这个，而不是普通饱和度。

**色差 (LCChromaticAberration)**
- 错开 RGB 通道，做出 3D / 复古镜头感
- 可分别调整红、绿、蓝的水平和垂直偏移  
💡 一点就够。可以试小相反数值（R +2，G –1，B –3）。

**锐化专业版 (LCSharpenPro)**
- **以真实感优先**的中调清晰度 + 边缘锐化（默认不是“描边/线稿感”）
- **Clarity** = 局部结构 · **Sharpen** = 更细的边缘 · **Strength** = 与原图的混合比例
- **Halo**，且锐化较高时会自动抬高 · **Skin protect** 保护脸部
- 高级：半径、混合模式、阴影/高光保护
- **预设会填充滑条**（一动滑条就变成 **Custom**）：
  - **写实：** Natural · Subtle · Portrait · Product · Landscape · Crisp  
  - **艺术：** Lineart · Anime sharp  
💡 网红/写实/NSFW 先用 **Natural** 或 **Portrait**，先加 clarity 再加 sharpen。只有需要明显线感时才用 **Lineart / Anime sharp**。

**图像调整 (LCImageAdjust)**
- 亮度、对比度、饱和度、锐度、模糊
- 亮度中心 = 0
- 对比度与饱和度中心 = 1

**LC Skin Beauty ✨**
- 详见 Skin Beauty ✨ 的 Markdown 说明文档

**镜头特效 (LCLensFX)**
- 通用镜头畸变和光学效果  
💡 和下一个节点一起用，模拟更真实的相机光学。

**镜头配置文件 (LCLensProfile)**
- 应用真实镜头特性（例如 Canon 50mm f/1.8）
- 可选色差  
💡 给 AI 图加一点真实光学瑕疵，照片感会强很多。

**黑白胶片 (LCFilmStockBW)**
- 用真实胶片光谱响应转黑白
- 50+ 种胶片（Ilford HP5+、Kodak Tri-X、Fuji Acros 等）
- 强度 + 可选滤镜  
💡 想留彩色就关掉这个。

**彩色胶片 (LCFilmStockColor)**
- 应用经典彩色胶片响应（Ektachrome、Portra 等）
- 强度是主要控制  
💡 0.6–0.9 往往比满强度更自然。

**胶片颗粒 (LCFilmGrain)**
- 可精细控制的真实胶片颗粒
- 强度、缩放、阴影/高光、种子  
💡 固定种子可以让颗粒保持一致。阴影区域颗粒稍强通常更好看。

**去饱和 (LCImageDesaturate)**
- 部分或完全去饱和
- 多种方法可选（luminance Rec.709 较常用）  
💡 在套 LUT 之前用，可以做出更柔和的基础色。

**应用 LUT (LCApplyLUT)**
- 套用 3D LUT（`.cube` 文件）
- 强度 0–1 · Log 选项（部分 LUT 需要）
- **不会从网上自动下载 LUT。**  
  请自行把 `.cube` 放到下面的目录（或保留节点包可能从 `assets/luts/` **一次性拷贝**到 `models/luts/` 的文件；**不会覆盖**你已有的同名文件）。

```
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    └── luts/
        ├── your_look.cube
        ├── film_emulation.cube
        └── ...
```

💡 免费 LUT：freshluts.com。强度 **0.3–0.7** 通常比 1.0 更好看。

**裁剪 (LCImageCrop)**
- 内联裁剪工具
- X / Y / 宽 / 高 或 free 模式  
💡 所有效果做完再裁，才不会丢掉边缘处理（暗角、光晕等）。

**文字叠加 (LCTextOverlay)**
- 在最终图上加文字
- 字体、大小、颜色、**对齐**（左 / 中 / 右）、位置、透明度
- 第 2 次运行时应用

**LC 水印 💧（LCWatermark）**
- 可动态将任意图片添加为水印
- 可调节大小、位置和透明度
- 第 2 次运行时应用效果

nodes.title: This is meant to be broken up. With all nodes it is very RAM heavy. Delete any node you do not need and it heals itself.
这是设计成可以拆开用的。节点全开时会非常吃内存。不需要的节点直接删掉，图会自己接好。
